saw_lines: Teachers and training managers buy when a specific problem lands on their desk, like a lesson due Sunday.
So the sale is won in the first line that names that exact problem, in the language the buyer uses at work.
Your 18 Google text ads read like developer error messages, not a teacher’s problem. Rebuild them around the lesson planning tool, then open the 12 video ads with it.
ads_1: Google text and video direction built on the teacher’s Sunday lesson problem
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
